meta.name: speech-to-text
meta.description: Transcribe audio to text with ElevenLabs Scribe and Whisper models via inference.sh CLI. Models: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (98%+ accuracy, diarization), Fast Whisper Large V3, Whisper V3 Large. Capabilities: transcription, translation, multi-language, timestamps, speaker diarization, audio event tagging. Use for: meeting transcription, subtitles, podcast transcripts, voice notes. Triggers: speech to text, transcription, whisper, audio to text, transcribe audio, voice to text, stt, automatic transcription, subtitles generation, transcribe meeting, audio transcription, whisper ai, elevenlabs stt, scribe, eleven labs transcribe

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把音频转成文字，支持多语言和说话人识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把录音快速转成可搜索的文字稿
copy.tagline_en: Transcribe audio to text with speaker diarization and multi-language support
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly convert recordings into searchable text

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过命令行将音频文件转成文字，支持多语言、时间戳、说话人识别和翻译。
howto.when: 当你要求转录音频、生成字幕或处理会议记录、播客等音频内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我转录这段会议录音
say.note: Claude 会调用模型生成文字稿。

say.text: 给这个视频生成英文字幕
say.note: Claude 会先提取音频再转录并添加时间戳。

say.text: 把这段法语录音翻译成英文
say.note: Claude 会使用翻译任务输出英文文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can transcribe audio files to text via command line, supporting multiple languages, timestamps, speaker diarization, and translation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to transcribe audio, generate subtitles, or process meeting recordings, podcasts, and other audio content.

say_en.text: Transcribe this meeting recording for me.
say_en.note: Claude will run the model to produce a transcript.

say_en.text: Generate English subtitles for this video.
say_en.note: Claude will extract audio, transcribe with timestamps, and create captions.

say_en.text: Translate this French audio to English.
say_en.note: Claude will use the translate task to output English text.
